microbial_reproducibility: PARTIAL: no universal genus; PRJNA1232647/2706 publication reports higher secondary fecal bile acids but no overall BA-gene difference
human_metabolite_observed: PASS: taurocholate and taurocholenate sulfate passed the frozen longitudinal four-model promotion gate; additional conjugated bile acids were directionally supportive
microbe_metabolite_link: FAIL: provenance-audited external BSH/T studies establish only in-principle chemistry; no linked patient-level taxon-function-metabolite measurement
metabolite_target_link: SUPPORTED-IN-PRINCIPLE: external receptor assays exist, but they do not test the project-promoted taurocholate/taurocholenate-sulfate signals and one human study found low systemic microbial conjugate exposure
host_reproduced_two_datasets: FAIL/PARTIAL: GSE63898 bulk bile-acid synthesis/transport was modestly lower, but receptor response was null and an aligned programme was not reproduced in two independent host datasets
single_cell_localisation: FAIL: hepatocyte synthesis/transport and receptor-response modules were null after ambient-RNA correction
major_contradiction_resolved: FAIL: higher circulating conjugated bile acids coexist with null single-cell hepatic programmes, a modest bulk-tissue synthesis/transport decrease, and cross-sectional fecal secondary-BA evidence
robust_to_analytic_choices: PARTIAL: promoted metabolite directions survive normalization and model changes; upstream microbial evidence is not stable
measured_evidence_summary: Strong human metabolite evidence but insufficient reproducible upstream microbial and downstream host evidence

candidate_family: Aromatic microbial metabolites and AHR/inflammatory signalling
microbial_reproducibility: FAIL: no harmonised microbial aromatic-metabolism function reproduced across cohorts
human_metabolite_observed: PASS-PARTIAL: gamma-glutamyltryptophan passed the strict all-pre-HCC longitudinal gate; 3-phenylpropionate was lower within 12 months but failed the high-coverage promotion requirement
microbe_metabolite_link: FAIL: external B. fragilis-to-3-PPA evidence is non-human and the producing taxon/function was not linked in project participants
metabolite_target_link: SUPPORTED-IN-PRINCIPLE ONLY FOR 3-PPA: provenance-audited mouse intestinal evidence supports an AhR edge, but no direct gamma-glutamyltryptophan-to-AhR evidence was identified
host_reproduced_two_datasets: FAIL/PARTIAL: the fixed AHR/aromatic module was lower in GSE63898 bulk tissue but has not reproduced in a second aligned host dataset
single_cell_localisation: FAIL: AHR modules were not significant after correction in hepatocyte, myeloid, endothelial, fibroblast or T/NK pseudobulks
major_contradiction_resolved: NO: bulk-tissue decrease conflicts with null donor-aware cell-type programmes and does not resolve the host bridge
robust_to_analytic_choices: PARTIAL: gamma-glutamyltryptophan was robust; 3-phenylpropionate direction was model-stable but coverage was low
measured_evidence_summary: Prospective aromatic-metabolite evidence is hypothesis-generating; the host AHR bridge remains contrast-dependent

microbial_reproducibility: FAIL: no reproducible cohort-level indole-production function
human_metabolite_observed: FAIL/PARTIAL: indole metabolites were detected but no prespecified robust longitudinal indole signal passed the current promotion gate
microbe_metabolite_link: FAIL: no project-linked microbial function-metabolite edge
metabolite_target_link: SUPPORTED-IN-PRINCIPLE at class level only; candidate-specific project metabolite evidence is absent
single_cell_localisation: FAIL: corrected AHR modules were null
robust_to_analytic_choices: NO: no promoted metabolite effect to perturb analytically
measured_evidence_summary: Does not pass the human-metabolite or host-response gates

candidate_family: Choline/acyl-choline metabolism and immune lipid handling
microbial_reproducibility: FAIL: no reproducible microbial choline-utilisation function available
human_metabolite_observed: PASS-PARTIAL: 1-palmitoleoyl-GPC passed the within-12-month longitudinal gate and publisher-identified glycerophosphocholine was lower in the 40-pair ST001152 tissue comparison; the direct 10-pair cirrhosis subset did not pass FDR
microbe_metabolite_link: FAIL: cutC and GPC-to-TMAO studies establish external pathway plausibility, but cutC/TMA/TMAO were not measured in project cohorts and no direct link exists for 1-palmitoleoyl-GPC
metabolite_target_link: SUPPORTED-IN-PRINCIPLE for GPC/TMAO only; external cardiovascular and HCC studies do not validate the project's exact acyl-GPC signal or fixed host programme
host_reproduced_two_datasets: FAIL: fixed bulk choline-phospholipid module was null in GSE63898 and is not reproduced in two datasets
single_cell_localisation: FAIL/PARTIAL: myeloid choline-phospholipid module was nominal only and did not pass global module FDR
robust_to_analytic_choices: PARTIAL: metabolite-class direction is supported across plasma and tissue but exact-metabolite double-FDR replication and upstream/downstream bridges are absent
measured_evidence_summary: Observed metabolite class without an eligible microbiota-host axis
